reading.title: Sleep and the modern world
reading.text: Doctors say that chronic lack of sleep is one of the biggest health problems of modern life. Our body clocks are synchronised with daylight, but artificial light and late-night screens confuse them. Some historians argue that the eight-hour working day is an anachronism from the factory age. A new book chronicles how people slept before electricity: many woke in the middle of the night for an hour before a 'second sleep'.
